messages:
Tasha R.: heads-up: iOS onboarding sample (swift-sdk) shows big burst of 429s after app-background/resume when prefetch>1 + concurrency=3. only on simulator/device, not on desktop.
Omar L.: interesting. any logs or repro steps?
Tasha R.: repro: build sampleapp ios, run with prefetch=2 concurrency=3, background app for ~10s, then foreground. after resume we see a spike:
```2025-02-10T09:12:03Z INFO app entering background
2025-02-10T09:12:13Z INFO app resumed
2025-02-10T09:12:13Z WARN refill catchup tokens_added=30 worker=all
2025-02-10T09:12:13Z ERROR request failed status=429 route=/v1/embeds detail=rate_limit_exceeded
```
Mei K.: sounds like timers paused in background and when app resumes the token-bucket does a catch-up refill all-at-once. mobile OS suspends timers, so wall-clock based refill + resume jitter is needed.
Tasha R.: exact. sampleapp had refill implemented with a repeating Timer that assumes continuous ticks. when paused, no ticks happen and then resume code runs refill loop which deposits full bucket and workers immediately drain it.
Omar L.: short-term mitigation we can ship in samples: 1) persist last_refill_ts to UserDefaults and compute tokens = min(cap, tokens + elapsed * rate) on resume; 2) add resume_jitter_ms random(0,250) before allowing workers to send; 3) reduce prefetch default to 1 for mobile.
Mei K.: long-term SDK fix: change Swift SDK token refill to wall-clock delta approach (no reliance on repeating timers), make auth refresh non-blocking, and add per-request reservation for pagination so a multi-page fetch can't take entire bucket on resume. also add mobile-specific doc note.
Tasha R.: I pushed a small sample patch to `examples/ios/onboard-resume-fix` that uses UserDefaults last_refill and a 0-200ms resume jitter; 5k rows ran without spikes in local device testing.
DevExBot: created issue: swift-sdk#512 - mobile background resume causes refill bursts -> triage required.
Omar L.: i'll open an SDK PR to switch to wall-clock refill + resume jitter and add an integration test in devex harness that runs an iOS simulator suspend/resume cycle with prefetch=2 and asserts <3 429s in any 10s window.
Mei K.: also recommend short onboarding doc blurb: "Mobile SDKs: prefer prefetch<=1, handle background/resume by computing refill from elapsed time, and upgrade to swift-sdk >=0.8.0". I'll draft the doc.
Tasha R.: repro artifacts and patched sample pushed. tagging @Omar L. and @Mei K. for follow-ups, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
